meta.what: Russia's federal budget oil and gas revenues and total revenues (monthly and yearly, 2019 to the latest month), fossil-fuel export revenue estimates (CREA monthly; IEA and Bank of Russia points) and defence spending for context. Research only; not wired into the build.
meta.units: RUB bn, EUR bn, USD bn nominal; share = oil and gas revenue / total federal revenue
meta.fx: Bank of Russia official daily rates, simple monthly average of the rates applying in the month (ECB has no RUB reference rate after 1 March 2022). Yearly EUR/USD = sum of monthly conversions.
meta.definition: Minfin 'нефтегазовые доходы': mineral extraction tax on oil, gas and condensate, export duties on oil, products and gas, the additional income tax (НДД) and, since 2019, minus the 'damper' payments to refiners and the reverse excise (they are netted in the oil MET). It is a budget (tax) concept, not export earnings: it includes tax on oil and gas sold at home and excludes companies' profits, profit tax and dividends (Gazprom/Rosneft dividends sit in non-oil-gas revenue).
meta.ytd_note: Minfin publishes cumulative figures from the start of each year; a month is the difference between consecutive cumulative figures, so in-year revisions land in the month published.

2023.plan_note: approx. 2023 budget level implied by Kommersant's +68.2% for 2024 (derived)

2026.plan_note: budget law as adopted (Nov 2025), before 2026 amendments
